title: opto-sync envelope for a route map
description: The RPC/route-map system publishes this document into opto-sync. opto-sync itself must not depend on ores-api-docs. Identity key is `id`; Last-Write-Wins keys are `updatedAt,syncedAt` — the same defaults as github.com/opto-sync/opto-sync-clients.

id.description: opto-sync array/object identity. Equal to record_id.

updatedAt.description: Digit-string or RFC 3339 timestamp. Digit strings survive JS Number rounding; see opto-sync-clients README.

payload.description: The route-map document (keys → HTTP routes plus typed query/path/body schemas).
